changelog:
* **fix: use Alignment.Center for update screen content Box** (e9db063)
  - Replace Alignment.CenterHorizontally with Alignment.Center in the update screen content Box.
* **feat: redesign update screen with Pixel-style UI** (0f1ce4d)
  - Rebuild the Update screen with a minimal back-arrow top bar and scrollable content.
  - Use a small monochrome update icon, left-aligned title and muted description text.
  - Render What's new changelog as plain document text without cards or borders.
  - Show the real installed version on the already-up-to-date state.
  - Keep all existing update, download, install and error logic unchanged.
* **feat: move Reset All into Miscellaneous settings** (d37abd4)
  - Remove the Reset All card and its confirmation dialog from the Settings page.
  - Add a red Reset All card at the bottom of the Miscellaneous screen.
  - Reuse the shared reset dialog state machine from the activity-scoped ViewModel.
* **feat: restructure settings into grouped sections** (4910365)
  - Group App Theme, Language and Currency rows into a single General card.
  - Merge Updates and Changelog rows into a single Update card.
  - Move Miscellaneous directly above Author and rename About Cash Figure to Author.
  - Add shared SettingsGroupCard, SettingsGroupRow and divider composables.
* **docs: add Bangla translation contribution guide** (998be45)
  - Explain that the Bangla translation is a work in progress and invite native speakers to contribute.
  - Add a step-by-step guide with real before/after string examples and build/test verification.
  - Document the exact commit structure including type prefixes, TEST section, Change-Id and sign-off.
  - Point to docs/FILES.md, the no-code issue path and PR etiquette rules.
* **style: upgrade settings icons to premium rounded badges** (4feb2c5)
  - Wrap every settings icon in a tinted rounded badge tile for a modern look.
  - Swap flat icons for Rounded-style premium icons across all settings rows.
  - Use an error-tinted badge for Reset All and primary tint for the rest.
* **fix: add missing haptic feedback in settings and changelog** (a2f873b)
  - Vibrate when toggling Screen Protection and currency denomination notes in Settings detail.
  - Vibrate when retrying the changelog load after an error.
